notes.title: Arcana Sands of Destiny will be released soon!
notes.notes:
Hello all friends!
 Our game Arcana Sands of Destiny will be released soon on the 10th of December!
Thank you all who supported us through time , we really appreciate it !
If you like this game please add it to your wishlist and tell a friend :)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431270/Arcana_Sands_of_Destiny/

Arcana: Sands of Destiny is a Hidden Object Adventure game. It will take you on a journey full of unlocking mysteries, discovering magical artifacts, solving puzzles and completing quests to find the answers you seek, all in a beautifully created Egyptian world at the beginning of the 20th century.

Explore 3 Ancient Realms + Bonus Chapter
More than 5 hours of Gameplay !
Unlock 15 Achievements
Hire Companions and Build your own Palace
Interactive animated characters with voiceovers
Hint system to help you through your adventure
